_comment: The affordance manifest (GUI-029): every grammar verb maps to the GUI surface that invokes it without the command bar. 'planned:GUI-033' rows are the apparatus-palette backlog; the protocol conformance suite fails on any grammar verb MISSING from this file, and reports the planned count so the sandbox-completeness invariant is tracked, not assumed.
